stem: Which scatterplot does NOT suggest a linear relationship between x and y?

options.label: A
options.text: Scatterplot A (showing an upward linear pattern)

options.label: B
options.text: Scatterplot B (showing a downward linear pattern)

options.label: D
options.text: Scatterplot D (showing no clear linear pattern)

visual_elements:
Four scatterplots labeled A, B, C, and D.
- Plot A shows points roughly along an upward slanting line.
- Plot B shows points roughly along a downward slanting line.
- Plot C shows points curving upwards in a nonlinear pattern.
- Plot D shows points scattered horizontally with no obvious linear pattern.
